info.title: LiteLLM-RS Admin Control Plane API
info.summary: Authenticated control-plane HTTP contract for the self-hosted LiteLLM-RS gateway
info.description: Auth, keys, teams, budgets, routing inventory, request ledger, provider configuration, routing policy, and cache administration. This document is served at GET /admin/openapi.json and requires an Admin-role caller when authentication is enabled. The stable inference contract remains GET /openapi.json and is intentionally separate. MCP, A2A, Realtime, and dashboard static assets are excluded. Response schemas omit api_key values, Authorization headers, prompt/body payloads, header maps, and raw secrets.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <jwt>, ApiKey <gw-...>, or a raw gw- prefixed key. Admin-tagged /admin/* JSON APIs additionally require an authenticated user with the Admin role (SuperAdmin satisfies has_role). API keys without that user context receive HTTP 403 with the AdminError envelope.

AdminError.description: Control-plane error using RFC 9110 status codes and the {success:false, error} JSON envelope

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required or credentials were rejected (RFC 9110 §15.5.2)

Forbidden.description: Authenticated caller lacks Admin role or other required permission (RFC 9110 §15.5.4)

api_key_ref.description: Environment variable name; never a secret value

api_key.description: Must be ${VAR} referencing an existing environment variable. Raw secrets are rejected. Never returned.

key.description: Plaintext key to verify; not echoed in responses
Plaintext key shown once on create
